evidence.quote: Also important is a patiently accommodative monetary policy stance that embraces the lessons of the past
Correcting this misclassification and counting those who have left the labor force since last February as unemployed would boost the unemployment rate to close to 10 percent in January
This means that we will not tighten monetary policy solely in response to a strong labor market.

we will continue to increase our holdings of Treasury securities and agency mortgage-backed securities by $80 billion and $40 billion per month, respectively, until substantial further progress has been made

These late-breaking improvements in the labor market did not result in unwanted upward pressures on inflation, as might have been expected; in fact, inflation did not even rise to 2 percent on a sustained basis.

parsed.rationale: The speech stresses a labor market very far from maximum employment, low inflation, and a patient, accommodative stance with continued asset purchases and no tightening on labor strength alone. The signal is strongly dovish.
